title_en: Course Registration for Designated Prerequisite Courses, Fall Semester (2nd Semester) of the 2026 Academic Year ('Programming Methodology' and 'Basic Electromagnetics and Practice')
summary: From the 2020 entrance year onwards, students may register for the designated prerequisite courses 'Programming Methodology' and 'Basic Electromagnetics and Practice' only if they meet the prerequisite condition. Whether the condition applies, and how to register, depends on the student's entrance year and on whether the prerequisite course has been completed.
applies_to: All students who wish to register for 'Programming Methodology' (430.211) or 'Basic Electromagnetics and Practice' (430.202B) in the 2nd semester of 2026. The Google Form application (Sections 3–5) is only for: (a) for Programming Methodology, students of the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (undergraduate main major, or second major as double major/minor), the College of Liberal Studies with this School as main major, and the interdisciplinary majors in AI Semiconductor Engineering, Intelligent Communications, and Artificial Intelligence, who entered in 2019 or earlier and have not completed the prerequisite course; (b) for Basic Electromagnetics and Practice, students of the School (undergraduate main major, or second major as double major/minor), the College of Liberal Studies with this School as main major, and the interdisciplinary major in AI Semiconductor Engineering, who entered in 2019 or earlier and have not completed the prerequisite course, or who entered in 2020 or later and have completed 'Advanced Physics 2' or 'General Physics and Lab 2'. Students who entered in 2020 or later and have not completed the prerequisite course cannot register by any method.

dates.what: Registration on the course registration website (students who have completed the prerequisite course)
dates.when: During the course registration period (dates not given in this notice)

dates.what: Over-quota application period, in which eligible students apply via the Google Form
dates.when: Not separately stated in this notice; see the Google Form application period below

dates.what: Google Form application period (not first-come, first-served; the deadline is strictly enforced)

Review and approval by the School
Manual entry into the registration system by the School

steps: Check your entrance year (2019 or earlier / 2020 or later) and whether you have completed the prerequisite course.

If you have completed the prerequisite course (any entrance year), register directly on the course registration website during the course registration period. Students who entered in 2020 or later and completed 'Advanced Physics 2' or 'General Physics and Lab 2' cannot register on the website and must use the Google Form instead.

If you are eligible for the Google Form application (see Section 3), adjust your maximum registrable credits (수강신청가능 학점) by 3 September (Thursday) so that adding the course will not exceed your limit.

Complete and submit the 'Request Form for Registration in Designated Prerequisite Courses' (선이수 지정 교과목 수강신청 요청서) on Google Forms at https://forms.gle/m4bCo2YLia9Uucrp6 (Chrome browser recommended) between 1 September (Tuesday) 09:00 and 3 September (Thursday) 18:00. Choose only one section per course, do not use abbreviations or slang (e.g., for college, department, student ID), and note that you can submit only once (with login).
If you need to change your submission, contact the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
The School will review and approve applications on 4 September (Friday) and enter approved registrations into the system by 7 September (Monday) 18:00.
translation:
Course Registration for Designated Prerequisite Courses, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year ('Programming Methodology' [프로그래밍방법론], 'Basic Electromagnetics and Practice' [기초전자기학 및 연습])
Posted: 27 July 2026

In our School, students of the 2020 entrance year or later cannot register for the designated prerequisite courses below unless they meet the prerequisite condition.
Whether the prerequisite condition applies, and the method of registration, differ according to entrance year (2019 or earlier / 2020 or later). Please be sure to read the information below and register using the method that applies to you.

① Students who entered in 2019 or earlier (up to the 2019 entrance year): the prerequisite condition does not apply.
 - Students who have completed the prerequisite course: register directly on the course registration website during the course registration period.
 - Students who have not completed the prerequisite course: apply through the Google Form during the over-quota application period [정원 외 신청 기간].

② Students who entered in 2020 or later (from the 2020 entrance year): the prerequisite condition applies.
 - Students who have completed the prerequisite course: register directly on the course registration website during the course registration period.
 - Students who have not completed the prerequisite course: cannot register, either on the course registration website or through the Google Form.

Note: Among students who entered in 2020 or later, those who have completed 'Advanced Physics 2' [고급물리학 2] or 'General Physics and Lab 2' [일반물리학 및 실험 2] are recognised as having completed the prerequisite course, but they cannot register on the course registration website. They must apply through the Google Form during the over-quota application period.

※ If a student who is not eligible applies through the Google Form, the application will be cancelled without separate notice. Please take care to avoid any disadvantage.

1. Information on designated prerequisite courses (applies from the 2020 entrance year)
(No further content for this section appears in the text of the notice. If it was provided as an image or attachment, that content was not read.)

2. Designated prerequisite courses offered in the 2nd semester of 2026
 - Programming Methodology [프로그래밍방법론] / 430.211(001)
 - Basic Electromagnetics and Practice [기초전자기학 및 연습] / 430.202B(001–003)

*** Please note that the information below is for students eligible for the Google Form application. ***

3. Eligible applicants
 - Programming Methodology
 As of the 2nd semester of 2026, students of the following groups: "School of Electrical and Computer Engineering undergraduate main major + second major (double major/minor); College of Liberal Studies [자유전공학부] (with the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering as main major); Interdisciplinary Major in AI Semiconductor Engineering [연합전공 인공지능반도체공학]; Interdisciplinary Major in Intelligent Communications [연합전공 지능형통신]; Interdisciplinary Major in Artificial Intelligence [연합전공 인공지능]", who entered in 2019 or earlier (up to the 2019 entrance year) and have not completed the prerequisite course.
 - Basic Electromagnetics and Practice
 As of the 2nd semester of 2026, students of the following groups: "School of Electrical and Computer Engineering undergraduate main major + second major (double major/minor); College of Liberal Studies [자유전공학부] (with the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering as main major); Interdisciplinary Major in AI Semiconductor Engineering [연합전공 인공지능반도체공학]", who entered in 2019 or earlier (up to the 2019 entrance year) and have not completed the prerequisite course, or who entered in 2020 or later and have completed 'Advanced Physics 2' [고급물리학2] or 'General Physics and Lab 2' [일반물리학및실험 2].

4. Application method and procedure
 - Method: Complete and submit the 'Request Form for Registration in Designated Prerequisite Courses (Google Form)' [선이수 지정 교과목 수강신청 요청서(구글 설문)].
 ※ Link: https://forms.gle/m4bCo2YLia9Uucrp6 (Chrome browser recommended)
 - Application period: 1 September (Tue) 09:00 – 3 September (Thu) 18:00 (not first-come, first-served; the deadline is strictly enforced)
 - Review and approval by the School: 4 September (Fri) 09:00–18:00
 - System entry: The School will enter registrations manually by 7 September (Mon) 18:00.
 ※ Applicants must adjust their maximum registrable credits [수강신청가능 학점] by 3 September (Thu) so that the limit is not exceeded and the course can be entered.

5. Important notes
 - Sections applied for by eligible Google Form applicants will be approved even if the section is full. (However, if you apply for several sections of the same course at the same time, the application will be cancelled.)
 - Only one section may be submitted per course; you may not apply for more than one section of the same course.
 - The "Request Form for Registration in Designated Prerequisite Courses" can be submitted only once (with login). If you wish to make changes after submitting, contact the department office and the change can be made.
 - Do not use abbreviations or slang in the "Request Form for Registration in Designated Prerequisite Courses" (e.g., for college, department, student ID).
 - Personal information collected will be used only for processing the "Request Form for Registration in Designated Prerequisite Courses".

6. Enquiries: Undergraduate Office, School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (the contact details are given in the original notice).
